description: Trace a manufacturing run to consumed material lots, material masters, and suppliers.
cypher:
MATCH (run:ManufacturingRun {runId: $runId})
MATCH (run)-[consumes:CONSUMES]->(lot:MaterialLot)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(material:Material)
MATCH (lot)-[:SUPPLIED_BY]->(supplier:Supplier)
RETURN run.runId AS runId,
       run.batchNumber AS batchNumber,
       lot.lotId AS lotId,
       lot.lotNumber AS lotNumber,
       material.materialId AS materialId,
       material.name AS material,
       material.materialRole AS role,
       consumes.quantityKg AS quantityKg,
       supplier.supplierId AS supplierId,
       supplier.name AS supplier,
       supplier.qualificationStatus AS supplierStatus
ORDER BY role, lotNumber;

description: Explain the deviation, triggering alarm, triggering reading, and supporting readings for one run.
cypher:
MATCH (run:ManufacturingRun {runId: $runId})-[:HAS_DEVIATION]->(dev:Deviation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (dev)-[:INVESTIGATES]->(alarm:Alarm)-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(triggeringReading:SensorReading)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(triggeringSensor:Sensor)
OPTIONAL MATCH (dev)-[:CONSIDERS_READING]->(supportingReading:SensorReading)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(supportingSensor:Sensor)
RETURN run.runId AS runId,
       dev.deviationId AS deviationId,
       dev.title AS deviationTitle,
       dev.severity AS severity,
       dev.status AS deviationStatus,
       alarm.alarmId AS alarmId,
       alarm.alarmCode AS alarmCode,
       alarm.severity AS alarmSeverity,
       triggeringReading.readingId AS triggeringReadingId,
       triggeringReading.timestamp AS triggeringTimestamp,
       triggeringSensor.name AS triggeringSensor,
       triggeringReading.value AS triggeringValue,
       triggeringReading.unit AS triggeringUnit,
       supportingReading.readingId AS supportingReadingId,
       supportingSensor.name AS supportingSensor,
       supportingReading.timestamp AS supportingTimestamp,
       supportingReading.value AS supportingValue,
       supportingReading.unit AS supportingUnit,
       supportingReading.status AS supportingStatus,
       dev.impactAssessment AS impactAssessment,
       dev.capa AS capa
ORDER BY supportingReadingId;

description: Find CDEs supporting a selected CTD Module 3 / CMC section.
cypher:
MATCH (section:RegulatorySection {sectionId: $sectionId})<-[:SUPPORTS_CMC_SECTION]-(cde:CriticalDataElement)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(uo:UnitOperation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cde)-[:MAPS_TO_STANDARD]->(standard:DataStandard)
WITH section, uo, cde, collect(DISTINCT standard.name) AS standardNames
RETURN section.sectionId AS sectionId,
       section.name AS cmcSection,
       uo.operationOrder AS operationOrder,
       uo.name AS unitOperation,
       cde.cdeId AS cdeId,
       cde.name AS cde,
       cde.domain AS domain,
       cde.criticality AS criticality,
       reduce(text = '', item IN standardNames | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS standards
ORDER BY operationOrder, cdeId;

description: Return core AI-readiness validation checks for CDE governance, grounding, value metadata, and provenance.
cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (cde:CriticalDataElement)
  WITH cde,
       EXISTS { (cde)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(:UnitOperation) } AS hasOperation,
       EXISTS { (cde)-[:SOURCED_FROM]->(:DataSourceSystem) } AS hasSource,
       EXISTS { (cde)-[:HAS_OWNER]->(:DataOwner) } AS hasOwner,
       EXISTS { (cde)-[:HAS_STEWARD]->(:DataSteward) } AS hasSteward,
       EXISTS { (cde)-[:HAS_DATA_QUALITY_RULE]->(:DataQualityRule) } AS hasRule,
       EXISTS { (cde)-[:MAPS_TO_STANDARD]->(:DataStandard) } AS hasStandard,
       EXISTS { (cde)-[:SUPPORTS_CMC_SECTION]->(:RegulatorySection) } AS hasCmcSection
  WITH 'CDE governance completeness' AS checkName, count(cde) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN hasOperation AND hasSource AND hasOwner AND hasSteward AND hasRule AND hasStandard AND hasCmcSection THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passing, collect(CASE WHEN NOT (hasOperation AND hasSource AND hasOwner AND hasSteward AND hasRule AND hasStandard AND hasCmcSection) THEN cde.cdeId END)[0..20] AS failures
  RETURN checkName, total, passing, reduce(text = '', item IN failures | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS failingExamples
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (cde:CriticalDataElement)
  WITH cde, EXISTS { (cde)-[:DESCRIBES]->() } AS hasGrounding
  WITH 'CDE semantic grounding' AS checkName, count(cde) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN hasGrounding THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passing, collect(CASE WHEN NOT hasGrounding THEN cde.cdeId END)[0..20] AS failures
  RETURN checkName, total, passing, reduce(text = '', item IN failures | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS failingExamples
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (cde:CriticalDataElement)
  WITH cde,
       EXISTS { (cde)-[:HAS_VALUE_DOMAIN]->(:ValueDomain) } AS hasValueDomain,
       EXISTS { (:CDEValue)-[:VALUE_OF]->(cde) } AS hasRepresentativeValue
  WITH 'CDE value metadata coverage' AS checkName, count(cde) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN hasValueDomain AND hasRepresentativeValue THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passing, collect(CASE WHEN NOT (hasValueDomain AND hasRepresentativeValue) THEN cde.cdeId END)[0..20] AS failures
  RETURN checkName, total, passing, reduce(text = '', item IN failures | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS failingExamples
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (mapping:StandardMapping)
  WITH mapping, EXISTS { (mapping)-[:SUPPORTED_BY_PROVENANCE]->(:ProvenanceStatement) } AS hasProvenance
  WITH 'Standard mapping provenance' AS checkName, count(mapping) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN hasProvenance THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passing, collect(CASE WHEN NOT hasProvenance THEN mapping.mappingId END)[0..20] AS failures
  RETURN checkName, total, passing, reduce(text = '', item IN failures | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS failingExamples
}
RETURN checkName, total, passing, failingExamples
ORDER BY checkName;

description: Trace one CDE definition to its representative value, value domain, run, reading evidence, and standards.
cypher:
MATCH (cde:CriticalDataElement {cdeId: $cdeId})
OPTIONAL MATCH (value:CDEValue)-[:VALUE_OF]->(cde)
OPTIONAL MATCH (value)-[:CONFORMS_TO_VALUE_DOMAIN]->(domain:ValueDomain)
OPTIONAL MATCH (domain)-[:USES_UNIT]->(unit:UnitOfMeasure)
OPTIONAL MATCH (value)-[:OBSERVED_DURING]->(run:ManufacturingRun)
OPTIONAL MATCH (value)-[:DERIVED_FROM_READING]->(reading:SensorReading)-[:RECORDED_BY]->(sensor:Sensor)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cde)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(uo:UnitOperation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cde)-[:MAPS_TO_STANDARD]->(standard:DataStandard)
WITH cde, value, domain, unit, run, reading, sensor, collect(DISTINCT uo.name) AS operationNames, collect(DISTINCT standard.name) AS standardNames
RETURN cde.cdeId AS cdeId,
       cde.name AS cde,
       cde.domain AS cdeDomain,
       cde.criticality AS criticality,
       reduce(text = '', item IN operationNames | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS observedAt,
       value.cdeValueId AS cdeValueId,
       value.numericValue AS numericValue,
       value.textValue AS textValue,
       value.status AS valueStatus,
       domain.name AS valueDomain,
       unit.symbol AS unit,
       run.runId AS runId,
       reading.readingId AS readingId,
       reading.timestamp AS readingTimestamp,
       sensor.name AS sensor,
       reading.value AS sensorValue,
       reading.unit AS sensorUnit,
       reduce(text = '', item IN standardNames | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS standards;

description: Return ordered observed values for one CDE across a manufacturing run, including units, sample points, and evidence type.
cypher:
MATCH (cde:CriticalDataElement {cdeId: $cdeId})
WITH cde, EXISTS { (:CDEValue {demoSeries: true})-[:VALUE_OF]->(cde) } AS hasSeries
MATCH (value:CDEValue)-[:VALUE_OF]->(cde)
WHERE hasSeries = false OR value.demoSeries = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (value)-[:CONFORMS_TO_VALUE_DOMAIN]->(domain:ValueDomain)
OPTIONAL MATCH (domain)-[:USES_UNIT]->(unit:UnitOfMeasure)
OPTIONAL MATCH (value)-[:OBSERVED_DURING]->(run:ManufacturingRun)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cde)-[:OBSERVED_AT]->(uo:UnitOperation)
WITH cde, value, domain, unit, run, collect(DISTINCT uo.name) AS operationNames
RETURN cde.cdeId AS cdeId,
       cde.name AS cde,
       reduce(text = '', item IN operationNames | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS observedAt,
       value.cdeValueId AS cdeValueId,
       value.sequence AS sequence,
       value.timestamp AS timestamp,
       value.numericValue AS numericValue,
       value.textValue AS textValue,
       value.status AS valueStatus,
       value.samplePoint AS samplePoint,
       value.evidenceType AS evidenceType,
       domain.name AS valueDomain,
       unit.symbol AS unit,
       run.runId AS runId
ORDER BY value.timestamp, value.sequence, value.cdeValueId;

description: List ordered process steps, equipment, and sensors used in a released manufacturing run.
cypher:
MATCH (decision:QAReleaseDecision)-[:RELEASES]->(run:ManufacturingRun {runId: $runId})
MATCH (run)-[:EXECUTES]->(:Recipe)-[defines:DEFINES_STEP]->(step:ProcessStep)-[:USES_EQUIPMENT]->(equipment:Equipment)
OPTIONAL MATCH (equipment)-[:HAS_SENSOR]->(sensor:Sensor)
WITH run, decision, defines, step, equipment, collect(DISTINCT sensor.name) AS sensorNames
RETURN run.runId AS runId,
       run.batchNumber AS batchNumber,
       decision.decision AS qaDecision,
       defines.stepOrder AS stepOrder,
       step.name AS processStep,
       equipment.equipmentId AS equipmentId,
       equipment.name AS equipment,
       equipment.equipmentType AS equipmentType,
       reduce(text = '', item IN sensorNames | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS sensors
ORDER BY stepOrder, equipment;

description: Trace a product to its regulatory filing, CMC package, and validation evidence.
cypher:
MATCH (product:Product {productId: $productId})
OPTIONAL MATCH (filing:RegulatoryFiling)-[:COVERS]->(product)
OPTIONAL MATCH (filing)-[:SUBMITS]->(cmc:CMCPackage)
OPTIONAL MATCH (evidence:ValidationEvidence)-[:SUPPORTS]->(filing)
RETURN product.productId AS productId,
       product.name AS product,
       product.description AS productDescription,
       filing.filingId AS filingId,
       filing.name AS filing,
       filing.region AS region,
       filing.status AS filingStatus,
       cmc.cmcPackageId AS cmcPackageId,
       cmc.name AS cmcPackage,
       evidence.evidenceId AS evidenceId,
       evidence.name AS evidenceName,
       evidence.evidenceType AS evidenceType,
       evidence.status AS evidenceStatus,
       evidence.summary AS evidenceSummary
ORDER BY evidenceId;

description: Return the ordered end-to-end operation path from a start operation to an end operation.
cypher:
MATCH path = (:UnitOperation {unitOperationId: $startOperationId})-[:NEXT_OPERATION*0..20]->(:UnitOperation {unitOperationId: $endOperationId})
UNWIND nodes(path) AS operation
RETURN operation.operationOrder AS operationOrder,
       operation.unitOperationId AS unitOperationId,
       operation.name AS unitOperation,
       operation.operationType AS operationType,
       operation.processMode AS processMode,
       operation.description AS description
ORDER BY operationOrder;

description: Return evidence documents supporting one CDE, its values, and related standard mappings.
cypher:
MATCH (cde:CriticalDataElement {cdeId: $cdeId})
OPTIONAL MATCH (doc1:EvidenceDocument)-[:EVIDENCES_CDE]->(cde)
OPTIONAL MATCH (doc2:EvidenceDocument)-[:EVIDENCES_CDE_VALUE]->(value:CDEValue)-[:VALUE_OF]->(cde)
OPTIONAL MATCH (doc3:EvidenceDocument)-[:SUPPORTS_MAPPING]->(mapping:StandardMapping)-[:MAPS_CDE]->(cde)
WITH cde, collect(DISTINCT doc1) + collect(DISTINCT doc2) + collect(DISTINCT doc3) AS docs
UNWIND docs AS doc
WITH cde, doc WHERE doc IS NOT NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (doc)-[:EVIDENCES_CDE_VALUE]->(value:CDEValue)-[:VALUE_OF]->(cde)
OPTIONAL MATCH (doc)-[:SUPPORTS_MAPPING]->(mapping:StandardMapping)-[:MAPS_CDE]->(cde)
WITH cde, doc, collect(DISTINCT value.cdeValueId) AS valueIds, collect(DISTINCT mapping.mappingId) AS mappingIds
RETURN cde.cdeId AS cdeId,
       cde.name AS cde,
       doc.documentId AS documentId,
       doc.title AS documentTitle,
       doc.documentType AS documentType,
       doc.status AS documentStatus,
       doc.summary AS documentSummary,
       reduce(text = '', item IN valueIds | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS supportedValueIds,
       reduce(text = '', item IN mappingIds | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS supportedMappings
ORDER BY documentId;

description: Compare released and rejected runs with QA decision, deviations, alarms, and consumed material lots.
cypher:
MATCH (run:ManufacturingRun)
OPTIONAL MATCH (decision:QAReleaseDecision)-[:RELEASES|REJECTS]->(run)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:HAS_DEVIATION]->(dev:Deviation)-[:INVESTIGATES]->(alarm:Alarm)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:CONSUMES]->(lot:MaterialLot)
WITH run, decision, collect(DISTINCT dev.deviationId) AS deviationIds, collect(DISTINCT alarm.alarmId) AS alarmIds, collect(DISTINCT lot.lotId) AS lotIds
RETURN run.runId AS runId,
       run.batchNumber AS batchNumber,
       run.status AS runStatus,
       run.disposition AS disposition,
       decision.decision AS qaDecision,
       decision.decisionId AS decisionId,
       reduce(text = '', item IN deviationIds | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS deviations,
       reduce(text = '', item IN alarmIds | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS alarms,
       reduce(text = '', item IN lotIds | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE '; ' END + item) AS materialLots
ORDER BY run.startTime;

description: Return CDE controlled vocabulary nodes for domain and criticality.
cypher:
MATCH (cde:CriticalDataElement {cdeId: $cdeId})
OPTIONAL MATCH (cde)-[:HAS_CDE_DOMAIN]->(domain:CDEDomain)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cde)-[:HAS_CRITICALITY_LEVEL]->(criticality:CriticalityLevel)
RETURN cde.cdeId AS cdeId,
       cde.name AS cde,
       cde.domain AS domainProperty,
       cde.criticality AS criticalityProperty,
       domain.name AS domainVocabulary,
       domain.description AS domainDescription,
       criticality.name AS criticalityVocabulary,
       criticality.description AS criticalityDescription;

description: Return the ontology predicate and allowed label pattern for a Neo4j relationship type.
cypher:
MATCH (rel:RelationshipDefinition {neo4jType: $neo4jType})
RETURN rel.neo4jType AS neo4jType,
       rel.ontologyPredicate AS ontologyPredicate,
       rel.subjectLabel AS subjectLabel,
       rel.objectLabel AS objectLabel,
       rel.cardinalityNote AS cardinalityNote,
       rel.description AS description;
